method: initialize + tools/list (anonymous, no tool called; roadmap#992)

tools.name: search_api
tools.description: Search the LangChain API reference documentation for classes, functions, and other symbols.

query.description: Search query (class name, function name, or keyword)

language.description: Programming language to search (defaults to all if not specified)

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 10, max: 50)

tools.name: get_symbol
tools.description: Get detailed documentation for a specific symbol including signature, parameters, and examples.

symbol.description: Symbol name or qualified path (e.g., ChatOpenAI, langchain_openai.ChatOpenAI)

language.description: Programming language to search within. Defaults to checking all languages when omitted.
